recalled_knowledge.item: Sellke-Bayarri-Berger bound B <= -1/(e p ln p); 14.60 at p = 4.7e-3
Expected information gain of an experiment = mutual information between hypothesis and outcome (Lindley 1956)
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: D. V. Lindley, Ann. Math. Stat. 27, 986 (1956)

recalled_knowledge.item: 'Garden of forking paths' as a name for uncorrected data-dependent analysis choices
Poisson rate with Gamma(r,1) posterior gives a negative-binomial predictive; log-uniform prior + one event -> Exponential(1) posterior, P(0) = 1/(1+k)

Reference class of ~3 sigma single-event / small-excess anomalies that resolved as background or artefact (CDMS-II Si, CRESST-II, XENON1T ER excess, 750 GeV diphoton); used only to motivate the parametrised base rate r = 0.01-0.3, no value adopted

failed_or_abandoned: A per-channel mixture model for H_U with dossier-relative weights was drafted and dropped: the weight of the unaccounted component is not separable from L_rest; the union (sum) treatment is used instead and is conservative against DM by at most x1.55 on L_acc.

Folding the historical base rate r into the hyper-prior as a sixth parameter was rejected as double-counting (r and pi_DM parametrise the same prior); r is reported as a translation to an implied pi_DM.
First version of the b_eff variant varied b with B_DM fixed, which wrongly rescaled L_DM (P027's B_DM scales as 1/b_H); corrected to hold L_DM = B_DM b_H fixed.
First Fig. 3 mixed nats and probability units on one axis; rebuilt as two panels.
